newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU's Cresson urges GAN sell-off.
newsitem.headline: EU's Cresson urges GAN sell-off.

text.p: European Commissioner Edith Cresson urged on Thursday a rapid privatisation of insurer GAN after the European Commission approved a massive 23.76 billion franc state-backed rescue of the company.
Asked during an interview on France Inter radio whether the Commission's approval on Wednesday had been a formality, she said, "Not at all, no, it is not a formality.

"French taxpayers have paid a lot of money for the national financial sector. So this situation, which takes in Credit Lyonnais and other institutions, does not enhance France's image in Brussels and makes our position more difficult in negotiations.
"So GAN must be privatised and measures need to be taken for other institutions, principally Credit Lyonnais," she said.
